mapper.select: select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, EFFICIENCY, TOOLING_INFO, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, REMARK from T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO where STATUS = '0' and DEL_FLAG = '0'

select BEAD_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') as machine_ids from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by BEAD_CODE

select mouth_plate_code, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') as machine_ids from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE sm inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0' and sm.status = '0' and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by MOUTH_PLATE_CODE
SELECT BEAD_CODE, max(MACHINE_ID) machine_ids FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY > 0 GROUP BY BEAD_CODE
